title: Apply – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: The 49th running takes place on Sunday 10 October 2027; the 2027 application window ran Thursday 8 October to Thursday 29 October 2026, with drawing status emailed Tuesday 8 December; the non-guaranteed drawing charges no application fee and removes duplicate submissions.

Guaranteed entry tracks are Time Qualifier, Legacy Finisher (five or more Chicago finishes in the last 10 years; finishes before 2016 do not count), Charity, High Performance Program, Chicago Distance Series finisher, 2026 cancelled entry and Para Athletics Program.

Time Qualifier results must come from a marathon run on a USATF/WA-certified course between 1 January 2025 and 29 October 2026; half-marathon or 50K times are not accepted, and non-certified races, personal device times, weather or conditions are not considered.
High Performance Program standards: men sub 2:25:00, women and non-binary sub 2:45:00, masters men sub 2:35:00, masters women and non-binary sub 2:50:00; masters are 40+; program capacity is 300.

Charity entries require fundraising of no less than US$2,500; the charity entry fee is US$325 for US residents and US$335 for non-US residents; charity places run first-come first-served until Friday 10 September 2027 or capacity.

Non-charity entry fee is US$250 for US residents and US$260 for non-US residents, plus a processing fee; participants must be 16 or older on race day; the course time limit is 6:30:59. Guaranteed entrants must pay by 11:59 p.m. CT Tuesday 10 November; drawing selectees by 11:59 p.m. CT Tuesday 15 December.
